answer: Ballot weight should be residual settlement, not a headcount of keys. Each voting agent must route genuine invoices through a public reef of independently custodied houses. After a multilateral netting delta, only the leftover—capped once per beneficial owner—counts. Invoices are replay-protected across the ocean of listed books, so wash loops that share a funder collapse to zero and slash the family's bond. Extra identities then consume capital instead of multiplying influence.
